note: UI Styles Views registers a Views display extender 'ui_styles' (Plugin\views\display_extender\Styles). hook_install appends 'ui_styles' to views.settings display_extenders (hook_uninstall removes it). Its options form has three ui_styles_styles selectors stored per display under display_options.display_extenders.ui_styles.{exposed_form_options, style_options, pager_options} (each a ui_styles.selected_mapping). preprocess_views_view injects classes onto exposed/rows/pager via addClasses(). No route/permission/settings form. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the module's real install effect on views.settings.display_extenders.

evals.prompt: With UI Styles Views, which three parts of a view can I apply UI Styles classes to?
evals.expected_output: Three parts: the exposed (filter) form, the Style/rows (result format), and the pager. They map to the display-extender option keys exposed_form_options, style_options and pager_options.

evals.prompt: How does UI Styles Views hook into Views, and what does it change in configuration when it is installed?
evals.expected_output: It provides a Views display extender plugin with id 'ui_styles'. On install it appends 'ui_styles' to views.settings > display_extenders so the extender is available on every view display; uninstall removes it.

evals.prompt: In UI Styles Views, where on a view display are the chosen style classes for the rows/pager/exposed form stored?
evals.expected_output: Under the display's display_options.display_extenders.ui_styles, in the keys exposed_form_options, style_options and pager_options, each a {selected, extra} mapping.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, determine whether the UI Styles Views display extender is active for views, and name the config object and key that lists it.
evals.expected_output: Yes: the display extender 'ui_styles' is listed in views.settings under display_extenders. Read with drush cget views.settings display_extenders.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, make the UI Styles Views display extender available to all views by enabling the correct module. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the ui_styles_views module (drush en ui_styles_views -y). Its hook_install adds 'ui_styles' to views.settings > display_extenders, so afterwards that list contains 'ui_styles'.
